Resolves #19900

A `#N` inside a Markdown link now stays part of that link, and an unknown ticket id no longer makes the Portal's tickets view load every chunk folder. Blog posts link Discussions and PRs whose text names their number. The ticket autolink ran on the raw Markdown and protected only code, so each such link split in two, and the second half opened the tickets view for a number that isn't a ticket. That view then walked the index's chunk folders one request at a time and showed nothing. Markdown links are now protected before the autolink, the way inline code already is. `ensureRecordLoaded` now returns `null` for an id the loaded id map does not name. The folder scan stays for a map that failed to load.

Evidence: L3 (headless Chrome on the Portal at head vs base) plus unit arms red on base. Residual: none.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `Markdown.spec.mjs` "a ticket id inside a Markdown link stays part of that link, and a bare one still becomes a ticket link" (red on base). |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: `tickets/MainContainerController.spec.mjs` "an id the loaded id map does not name loads no folder and resolves to null" (red on base). Its other two arms, "an id the map names loads exactly its folder" and "without a map, the folders are scanned until the id turns up", keep today's behaviour. |
| AC-3 | Headless Chrome against the dev server, the Portal with dedicated workers so its fetches are visible, and `useAiClient: false`. `the-organism-already-existed` renders 3 Discussion links at head, each one anchor to its URL; at base the same text splits into 6, each `#14422` half pointing at `#/news/tickets/14422`. `#/news/tickets/14422` makes 2 requests at head (the index and the id map) against 27 in 8 s at base, still scanning. `#/news/tickets/10074` loads 1 chunk at head. |

## Deltas from ticket

- The map is trusted as complete because it is: `idMap.json` names 11,644 tickets, every leaf in the chunk files, with 0 missing.
